misprints.note: Circumflex printed on the final syllable of ἀρετήν under Dygdig; kept as printed.
Grave accent printed before a full stop under Dygdemönster; kept as printed.
Under Dvala the print has b) with no preceding a); kept as printed.

uncertain.note: Under Dvala the breathing on the initial α looks a little like a grave accent. I read it as a smooth breathing.
The diacritic on οἷον is small. I read it as a rough breathing with a circumflex.
